title: Cops Keep Getting Arrested for Using Flock to Stalk People
summary: 404 Media reports on more than a dozen cases nationally where police officers have used Flock ALPR systems to stalk people, leading with the case of Orange City, Florida officer Jarmarus Brown, who ran his ex-girlfriend's plate 69 times and her parents' plates dozens more times in summer 2024. A colleague warned Brown to stop, per a police affidavit obtained by the outlet.

key_quotes.quote: For months during the summer of 2024, Jarmarus Brown, an Orange City, Florida police officer, ran his ex-girlfriend's license plate through the Flock automated license plate reader (ALPR) system lookup database at least 69 times.
There have been more than a dozen cases around the country where police use Flock to obsessively and illegally stalk people.
Officer King said he mentioned to Jarmarus that he needed to stop running her vehicle in that system because he could get in trouble.
